Subject: Initial redlines for MSA + publicity section for pilot

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the pilot timeline looks good. Attached are our redlines to the MSA (ACME_MSA_redlines_v3.docx). Two specific asks from our side:

1) We need a clear embargo window for any public announcement tied to pilot completion (we usually request a 30-day embargo after the pilot completion date so we can prepare comms).
2) Logo usage: Exhibit A lists approved logo lockups; we can grant a co-marketing logo placement on our website only after successful pilot sign-off and a short quote from our product lead.

We struck a balance in the attached between being protective of customer data and enabling joint marketing. Please confirm whether Redwood can provide a short testimonial template and who on your side will sign off on the quote.

Elena

Thanks Elena — received. Looping in Legal (Neha) and Product (Dev) for implications and sign-off. Quick thoughts before you dig in:

- Embargo: Redwood is usually comfortable with a 30-day embargo post-pilot, but we prefer an exception for a short case-study (one paragraph) with mutual review. Want to propose: embargo for press release; case-study permitted after mutual review and with a short proof point agreed.
- Logo: product-led placements are fine; we need to lock a single hero logo treatment and a release process (brand checklist + final approval within 48 hours).

Action items: Neha — please review the proposed confidentiality carveouts and the redline on publicity (see attached). Dev — confirm we can provide a 2–3 line technical quote and who will be the point of contact for Acme's product lead.

Priyom Das

Priyom / Marissa — reviewed ACME_MSA_redlines_v3.docx and made targeted suggestions. Summary of legal position:

- Confidentiality carveout for announcements: Accept 30-day embargo for press releases. Counter-proposal: require a 5-business-day review period for any quote or case study content rather than open-ended mutual review. This preserves our ability to meet marketing deadlines.
- Logo usage: we will permit logo use ONLY for the pilot announcement and product page if Acme follows the ExhibitA specs and sends final creative for review. Add a clause that logo usage is revocable on written notice if misuse occurs.
- Attribution/quote: require sign-off by our CPO for any technical quote; marketing may approve customer-facing blurb.

I inserted specific redline language in the doc at Section 6.2 and 7.1. Also flagged an IP cross-license sentence we should remove. Please see my inline comments.

Neha Kapoor
